angels3: Hey, everyone! It's that time of year again... and this Christmas, the whole branch is coming together.
So mark your calendars for Friday, December the eleventh. That's our Christmas luncheon, and with it, our Earthling and Angel gift exchange! As for the venue, we'll let you know very soon.
So, here's how it works. Every one of us is someone's Angel... and every one of us is someone's Earthling.
First, you join in. Just open the page and sign in with your agent number. And staff, simply type your name. That's it!
Next, list three gifts you'd really love to get, and anything your Angel should steer clear of.
Sign up closes at twelve noon, on Friday the twentieth of November. And that very same afternoon, at two o'clock, we do the draw.
After that, you'll get a private email telling you who your Earthling is, along with their wish list. Now remember... keep it a secret!
And between now and the luncheon, you can send your Earthling a few anonymous notes from the page. They'll never guess it's you.
Then pick out a gift, up to three hundred dollars. Wrap it up nicely, and label it with your Earthling's name.
Bring it along to the luncheon, where we'll exchange the gifts, and every Angel is finally revealed!
Every member of staff, and every active agent, is invited. So don't wait. Join today, using the link on your screen.
From all of us at the branch, Merry Christmas... and we'll see you at the luncheon!
